items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers remote code execution, actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical flaw (CVSS 10.0) which affects versions 2.4.4 up to and including 2.4.9.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to this update.

items.title: Incorrect authorization vulnerability leading to unauthenticated customer account takeover
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) that allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining elevated access to sensitive resources. This vulnerability is part of APSB26-92 and has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: XML external entity injection in the REST API (CosmicSting)
items.summary: An XML external entity injection vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) allowing unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files (e.g., env.php) and, when chained with CVE-2024-2961, execute code. This bug, initially patched in August 2024, is considered the 'worst bug to hit Magento and Adobe Commerce stores in two years' and has seen mass exploitation.

items.title: Stored cross-site scripting vulnerability
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges. This is one of the vulnerabilities addressed in APSB26-92.

items.title: Incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. This vulnerability was resolved as part of APSB26-92.

items.title: Stored cross-site scripting vulnerability
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges. This vulnerability is included in APSB26-92.

items.title: Incorrect-authorization vulnerability enabling security-feature bypass
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges. This issue was addressed in APSB26-92.

items.title: Incorrect-authorization vulnerability enabling security-feature bypass
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability (CVSS 6.5) that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges. This vulnerability is part of the APSB26-92 update.

items.title: Incorrect-authorization vulnerability resulting in privilege escalation
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability (CVSS 2.7) that could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges. This vulnerability was resolved in APSB26-92.
